info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Ferrier Notebook Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Ferrier Notebook Details Management API facilitates the creation of detailed entries for Ferrier notebooks in the catalog. This service allows businesses to add specific attributes and features of the notebooks, enhancing the overall product offering. It is designed for use by product managers and inventory systems that require precise product information to manage catalog entries efficiently. By utilizing this API, companies can ensure that their Ferrier notebook offerings are comprehensive and up-to-date.

post.summary: Create a new ferrier notebook detail.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new entry in the ferrier notebook, enabling the management and tracking of detailed records associated with ferrier activities.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to provide the necessary details for creating or updating a Ferrier notebook entry. The content must be structured according to the defined schema, which outlines the required fields and their formats.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning detailed notebook information.
